study_design: Nationwide randomized, placebo-controlled trial with a two-by-two factorial design
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 25,871 participants, including 5106 black participants, underwent randomization.
reason: The trial reports incident prostate cancer as a secondary endpoint but does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal prostate cancer incidence analysis. Death from cancer is an all-cancer mortality endpoint, not an aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In the analyses of secondary end points, the hazard ratios were as follows: for death from cancer (341 deaths), 0.83 (95% CI, 0.67 to 1.02); for breast cancer, 1.02 (95% CI, 0.79 to 1.31); for prostate cancer, 0.88 (95% CI, 0.72 to 1.07);
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is explicitly for prostate cancer overall in the vitamin D versus placebo comparison; it is not identified as an aggressive subtype.
